text:
alex: kicking off blue/green for eu-west — change window 12:30-13:00 UTC. planning a staged traffic shift to green (service v2). tagging @sre-oncall and @marta to watch routing + session affinity.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: green group -> v2 (service=models-api, image=models-api:2026-03-20-v2). id=deploy-3591023456. starting canary at 5%.

marta: please pin session-affinity on the router for 10m post-shift. last time sticky sessions caused split failures.

kai: agree. recommend 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m soak at 25% and 3m at 50%. health probe interval 30s.

jamal: logs from the first minute look clean, no 5xx spikes. p95 latency unchanged.

sre-oncall: threshold for rollback: any sustained error rate > 10% over 2m or p95 > 800ms for 3 consecutive probes. I'll escalate if we hit either.

alex: applying router change now. routerctl config snippet:
```
traffic-split:
  - backend: v1
    weight: 95
  - backend: v2
    weight: 5
sessionAffinity: true
```

deploy-bot: Canary health checks: 12/12 OK, prometheus: no new firing alerts for models-api. canary passed initial window.

product-ops: updated release-notes draft: added note about session affinity and fallback policy. link: https://confluence/release/eu-green-shift

alex: ramping to 25% in 1m. @kai please confirm readiness for the 5m soak.

kai: ready. monitoring dashboards up: p50/p95/p99 and error rate. will post if anything anomalous.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp executed: 25% -> 50% scheduled at +5m.

jamal: quick sanity: memory usage on green pods ~ stable, no OOMs.

sre-oncall: no alerts so far. p95 at 210ms, errors 0.4%. proceeding with next ramp when timer hits.

marta: pinning backend on LB temporarily to avoid crossover; command I ran:
`routerctl pin --backend v2 --duration 15m --reason "post-shift session-affinity"`

alex: rolling to 100% in 3m if all looks good. reminder: if a rollback is needed run:
`routerctl rollback --to v1 --drain --grace 60s`

deploy-bot: 50% traffic shift completed. metric snapshot: error_rate=0.6%, p95=230ms.

sre-oncall: holding for 3m. if stable, proceed to 100%. I will trigger rollback if >10% error or p95 > 800ms.

deploy-bot: Final shift to green complete. deploy-3591023456 status=SUCCESS. Note: persisted session-affinity for 10m. If rollback requested, use the rollback command above.

alex: nice. filing short postmortem checklist and will update the release notes. thanks everyone, closing the window early at 12:55 UTC since all checks are green :thumbsup:
